framework: RTL Sockets unit (hand-rolled HTTP; fphttpserver is IPv4-only)
build: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends fpc binutils && cp shared/page.html page.html && cp shared/index-url.txt index_url.txt && ld -r -b binary -o assets.o page.html index_url.txt og.png && mkdir -p .fpcout && fpc -O2 -Xs -FE. -FU.fpcout -oapp app.pas
